drive_candidate_confirmed_required.name: drive_candidate_confirmed_required
drive_candidate_confirmed_required.value: "drive_candidate"."review_state" <> 'confirmed' or ("drive_candidate"."email" is not null and length(btrim("drive_candidate"."name")) > 0)

drive_candidate_duplicate_required.name: drive_candidate_duplicate_required
drive_candidate_duplicate_required.value: ("drive_candidate"."review_state" = 'duplicate') = ("drive_candidate"."duplicate_of" is not null) and "drive_candidate"."duplicate_of" is distinct from "drive_candidate"."id"

interview_assessment_version_chain.name: interview_assessment_version_chain
interview_assessment_version_chain.value: ("interview_assessment_version"."version" = 1 and "interview_assessment_version"."previous_version_id" is null and "interview_assessment_version"."correction_reason" is null) or ("interview_assessment_version"."version" > 1 and "interview_assessment_version"."previous_version_id" is not null and length(btrim("interview_assessment_version"."correction_reason")) > 0 and "interview_assessment_version"."correction_reason" is not null)

interview_round_l1_qualification.name: interview_round_l1_qualification
interview_round_l1_qualification.value: ("interview_round"."qualifying_l1_round_id" is null and "interview_round"."qualifying_l1_version_id" is null) or ("interview_round"."level" = 'l2' and "interview_round"."qualifying_l1_round_id" is not null and "interview_round"."qualifying_l1_version_id" is not null)
